projects.name: Chickpea Fusarium Wilt Detector — MSDS Thesis
projects.summary: Development of Hybrid Lightweight CNN Integrating SqueezeNet and CBAM for Edge Deployment Using Multi-Data Sources. Published in Procedia Computer Science (Elsevier / ICCSCI 2026).
highlights: Designed a novel hybrid CNN (SqueezeNet v1.1 + CBAM) achieving 82.09% cross-domain accuracy on unseen Myanmar field test set — outperforming MobileNetV2, EfficientNet-B0, and ShuffleNet
Applied INT8 static quantisation: 3.31× model compression (final size: 0.870 MB) for real-time mobile inference with zero accuracy degradation
Benchmarked across 115 real Android devices via Google AI Edge Portal (worst-case CPU inference: 73.7 ms, compatible with 2 GB RAM / Android 9.0+)
Personally collected field dataset from Myanmar farming communities with expert agronomist annotation (inter-rater reliability with Cohen's κ)
Full statistical validation: Wilcoxon signed-rank test, two-proportion z-test with Wilson confidence intervals, McNemar's test, 5-fold stratified cross-validation

projects.name: Shwe Taungthuu — Myanmar Agricultural Advisory Agent
projects.summary: AI-powered bilingual agricultural advisory app for Myanmar farmers. Presented at Google Developers Community Build with AI MMDT 2026.
highlights: Real-time agricultural advisory generation powered by Google Gemini 2.5 Flash via Vertex AI
Accepts crop and pest management questions via Burmese voice or text input with structured advisory outputs
Python + FastAPI backend deployed serverlessly on Google Cloud Run with Application Default Credentials (ADC) keyless authentication
Frontend with Web Speech API for voice-to-text, Tailwind CSS, and inline voice history replay for low-literacy field contexts

projects.name: Bean Disease Classification via Stepwise CNN Fine-Tuning
projects.summary: Improving Bean Disease Classification with Stepwise Fine-Tuning of CNN-based Transfer Learning Models (MSDS Coursework 2025).
highlights: Benchmarked 5 pretrained CNN architectures (VGG16, ResNet50, DenseNet121, EfficientNet-B0, MobileNetV2); identified ResNet50 as optimal backbone
Designed stepwise fine-tuning strategy with progressive unfreezing of layers achieving 98.86% test accuracy
Fully reproducible end-to-end pipeline in a single Kaggle notebook

projects.name: Wikipedia Web Traffic Prediction via Time Series Modelling
projects.summary: Comparative study of 7 time-series models on a 145,000-article Wikipedia Kaggle dataset (MSDS Coursework 2025).
highlights: Evaluated Moving Average, Exponential Smoothing, ARMA, ARIMA, Auto-ARIMA, Prophet, and LSTM using RMSE
Identified Moving Average as the best-performing model, demonstrating simpler statistical methods outperformed deep learning on this task
Co-authored with Prof. Sandhya Avasthi, ABES Engineering College, India

projects.name: Myanmar Address Geocoding (BERT vs DistilBERT)
projects.summary: Transformer-based geospatial NLP system fine-tuned on 610,509 Myanmar addresses for coordinate regression (MMDT Deep Learning A+).
highlights: Fine-tuned BERT-multilingual, DistilBERT-multilingual, and XLM-RoBERTa on 610,509 Myanmar addresses
Custom Haversine distance loss (90% geographic + 10% MSE) to optimize kilometer-level real-world accuracy
Deployed live interactive Streamlit demo with map visualization on Hugging Face Spaces

projects.name: ML Algorithms from Scratch
projects.summary: 5 core machine learning algorithms implemented entirely from first principles using NumPy — MSDS Coursework 2025-2026.
highlights: Implemented Linear Regression, Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, KNN, and Naive Bayes from first principles without sklearn for core logic
Paired with rigorous mathematical formula derivations, step-by-step written explanations, and visualisations
Validated on real-world datasets (Naive Bayes 90.00% on Iris; KNN best k=5 at 72.73% on Pima Indians Diabetes)
